note: Lower Platte North NRD recreation area on 662-acre Lake Wanahoo, ~2 mi N of Wahoo on Hwy 77 (formerly run as a state SRA). Campground on the west shore: herringbone gravel electric pads off two park roads, the eastern row facing the lake; tent sites, primitive cabins, shower house at the southwest end. Little shade. No-wake boating; three-lane boat ramp; hike/bike trail round the lake. Generators until 10 p.m. --Claude
summary: Lake Wanahoo is now run by the Lower Platte North NRD, not Nebraska Game and Parks (it is off the NGPC grid and books through Set Your Sites, not ReserveAmerica). The NRD page and booking engine confirm 95 electric gravel pads (30/50 A) at $25, a shower house, a dump station on the east side, half the sites reservable, a 14-night limit and a $5 day park permit; all written. No site has a water hookup in the booking engine and the NRD names only electric, so the derived water value is cleared. Lakefront holds for the east row of the eastern road on imagery. Ownership, name, website and phone need changing (flags).
flags: OWNERSHIP state -> local: the Lower Platte North Natural Resources District runs it ('Lake Wanahoo NRD Recreation Area'; Nebraskaland: 'Lower Platte North NRD to assume management of Lake Wanahoo recreation area'). An NRD is a regional authority, so `local` under the curation doc. It is not on NGPC's 2025 grid nor on nebraskastateparks.reserveamerica.com. apply.py doesn't write ownership.
